description_en: Checks whether a Prometheus service or product is activated
description_zh: 检查Prometheus服务或商品开通状态
kebab_example: aliyun cms get-cms-service --product prometheus --service prometheus --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCmsService

parameters.help_en: prometheus: Checks the activation status of the Prometheus service. The service is billed by reported data volume or written data volume
parameters.help_zh: prometheus：prometheuse服务（按上报量或写入量计费）开通状态
parameters.name: product

parameters.help_en: prometheus: Checks whether the Prometheus product that is billed by reported data volume is activated.prometheusgb: Checks whether the Prometheus product that is billed by written data volume is activated
parameters.help_zh:
prometheus：prometheus上报量计费商品是否开通。
prometheusgb：prometheus写入量计费商品是否开通
parameters.name: service

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the service or product is activated

errorCode.description_en: PROM_NOT_OPEN: Prometheus is not activated.SLS_NOT_OPEN: Simple Log Service (SLS), a dependency of Prometheus, is not activated.CMS_SLR_NOT_EXIST: The service-linked role (SLR) for CloudMonitor does not exist.SLS_SLR_NOT_EXIST: The SLR for SLS does not exist
errorCode.description_zh:
PROM_NOT_OPEN：prometheus未开通。
SLS_NOT_OPEN：prometheus依赖的sls未开通。
CMS_SLR_NOT_EXIST：cloudmonitor SLR未创建。
SLS_SLR_NOT_EXIST：SLS SLR未创建
